usedFor: ClickBank sends each sale as a “New Transaction Postback”, and HubSpot keeps the buyer through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transaction Postback” in ClickBank, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each postback becomes a deal, so every order lands in the pipeline without retyping.

watchOut: “New Transaction Postback” also fires for events such as order form impressions, so filter before “Create Deal” runs.
